title: Corps suits round 4
desc: C8b kept, shown in four new textures; the suit-up now forms every piece, with the reveal light in the corps colour (not green); C5b brick with gauntlet hands; three new designs from C8b.

takes.name: Crest Knight as kept, suit-up fixed
takes.facts: Violet, carbon weave; every piece forms under the rising light; reveal band and ring flare in violet

takes.name: C8b in circuit
takes.facts: Blue; dark plate with thin glowing traces and pads

takes.name: C8b in hex plate
takes.facts: Red; raised hex cells, glowing gaps

takes.name: C8b in scale mail
takes.facts: Yellow; overlapping scales with lit lower rims

takes.name: C8b in pinstripe alloy
takes.facts: Orange; brushed metal, fine glowing lines

takes.name: Ribbed Warden, gauntlet hands
takes.facts: Orange brick; thick cuffs with a glowing rim, armoured fists, knuckle ridge

takes.name: Crest Heavy
takes.facts: Violet carbon; C8b + three-layer gauntlets, pauldron caps, thigh plates

takes.name: Crest Spine
takes.facts: Blue circuit; C8b + back fins, forearm blades, tall head crest

takes.name: Crest Warlord
takes.facts: Red hex plate; C8b + chest chevrons, faceplate horns, spiked gauntlets
